escapes.why: Promise<Store> goes into a Promise<unknown> slot, which drops it
escapes.safe: inBackground(what, work: Promise<unknown>) only hands it to counted(), which chains .then(() => undefined, () => undefined), adds that new promise to the inFlight Set and deletes it when it settles; settled() awaits Promise.allSettled([...inFlight]) and reads no result. The Store and its workspace are never read from it.
